  `cast` = 'Charlie Cox as Matt Murdock / Daredevil, Jon Bernthal as Frank Castle / The Punisher, Elodie Yung as Elektra Natchios, Deborah Ann Woll as Karen Page, Elden Henson as Foggy Nelson, Vincent D''Onofrio as Wilson Fisk',
  tagline = 'The Devil meets The Punisher. When justice fails, who decides who lives and who dies?',
  description = 'Daredevil Season 2 raises the stakes as Matt Murdock faces two new threats: Frank Castle, a violent vigilante known as The Punisher who believes in permanent justice, and Elektra, Matt''s dangerous ex-girlfriend who pulls him back into the war against The Hand.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/daredevil-s2-featured-6Qvd8xnRyMMhdVFDjfZCLq.webp',
  episodeCount = 13,
  seasonCount = 2,
  platform = 'Netflix',
  rtCriticsScore = 77,
  rtAudienceScore = 88,
  verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## Daredevil S2 Cards: Punisher''s First Appearance Premium

Daredevil Season 2 cards carry extra weight because of Jon Bernthal''s iconic Punisher debut. Cards featuring The Punisher from **2018 Upper Deck Defenders** and **2019 Upper Deck Marvel Premier** command significant premiums. The Punisher skull imagery has become one of the most recognizable symbols in pop culture, making these cards crossover collectibles that appeal beyond typical Marvel card collectors.',
  keyCards = '- **2018 Upper Deck Defenders Punisher First Appearance** — Jon Bernthal''s debut as Frank Castle in card form, $15-40
- **2018 Upper Deck Defenders Elektra Insert** — Elodie Yung''s Elektra cards are undervalued, $5-15
- **2019 Marvel Premier Daredevil/Punisher Dual Card** — Rare dual character cards, $20-50
- **2017 Upper Deck Marvel Annual Punisher Rookie** — Early Bernthal Punisher card, $10-30',
  content = '## The Punisher Arrives

Daredevil Season 2 is really two shows in one — and the first half might be the best thing Marvel has ever put on television. Jon Bernthal''s Frank Castle is a force of nature, and his philosophical debates with Matt Murdock about the nature of justice created some of the most compelling television of the decade. The rooftop conversation between Daredevil and Punisher remains one of the most quoted scenes in Marvel history.

## The Stairwell Fight

If Season 1 had the hallway fight, Season 2 answered with the stairwell fight — a brutal, extended sequence that somehow topped its predecessor. The choreography, the stakes, the chain wrapped around Daredevil''s fist — it was a masterclass in action filmmaking on a TV budget.

## Elektra and The Hand

The second half pivots to Elektra and The Hand mythology, which divided fans. While Elodie Yung brought incredible chemistry with Charlie Cox, the ninja storyline couldn''t quite match the grounded intensity of the Punisher arc. Still, it set up The Defenders and gave us one of Marvel''s great tragic romances.

## Fun Facts

- Jon Bernthal visited with real veterans and law enforcement to prepare for the role
- The stairwell fight was filmed in one continuous take over multiple days
- The Punisher was so popular he got his own spinoff series
- Vincent D''Onofrio''s Fisk return was kept secret until the episode aired
- The courtroom scenes were praised by actual lawyers for their accuracy',
  metaDescription = 'Daredevil Season 2 (2016) complete guide — Punisher debut, Elektra saga, trading card market analysis, key cards to collect, and why this season launched a franchise.',
  keywords = 'daredevil season 2, punisher, jon bernthal, frank castle, elektra, charlie cox, netflix marvel, marvel cards, the hand',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Punisher Daredevil cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Should I watch Daredevil Season 2 before The Punisher?","answer":"Yes, Daredevil Season 2 introduces Frank Castle and his origin story. The Punisher series picks up directly after these events."},{"question":"Is the stairwell fight in Season 2 one take?","answer":"Yes, the famous stairwell fight in Episode 3 was designed as a single continuous shot, similar to the hallway fight in Season 1 but even more ambitious in scope."},{"question":"Does Kingpin appear in Season 2?","answer":"Yes, Vincent D''Onofrio returns as Wilson Fisk in a pivotal prison scene with Frank Castle that sets up Season 3."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'daredevil-season-2-2016'
